dashboard.label: Web Application Command Injection Investigation
dashboard.description: Isolated lab evidence, 28 October 2026. All times UTC. Fixed investigation windows.

html.p: DetectionOnly allowed command execution and one harmless text download. The identical download input was blocked after enabling prevention. The normal ping still worked.
Short id was not detected. One earlier compressed calibration record has incomplete JSON fields; its original bytes are preserved. Blank mode does not mean the WAF was off.
